text: maya: quick follow-up from the console review — noticed a few small things in the audit-log/list view when KMS badges are shown densely. can we discuss? sam: saw that. the KMS badge pushes the timestamp to a new line in compact rows. looks cramped. :grimacing: joel: yeah, on narrow widths the row height jumps. we currently render badges after the action column which causes wrapping. maya: would swapping badge earlier help? e.g., move KMS badge next to the user so the timestamp stays right-aligned. sam: helper thought: badge placement + reduced horizontal padding for compact rows. also consider a tooltip for full key name if truncated. anya: careful: tooltip for key names has to avoid exposing full key id in sensitive contexts. we can show partial id + suffix, and link to key details page behind permission check. lina: a11y nit — if we truncate and add tooltip, ensure keyboard focusable and aria-label includes full visible label but not raw key material. screen readers should read "Using customer-managed key" not the hex. joel: implementing a11y-friendly tooltip + visually hidden text is fine. sample HTML:```CMK``` maya: also, the compact mode default in settings is labeled "Compact density" — a bunch of PMs thought the retention/region rows looked like they lost context. any copy tweaks? sam: suggestion: change "Compact density" label to "Compact rows (save space)" and add a short inline hint: "Keeps one-line audit entries where possible." anya: backend impact: one-line mode will hide long metadata fields (we already collapse message details). need a fallback to expand row. ok to show "Show details" chevron. maya: retention copy — in the retention column we say "Session: 90 days" but people asked what "Session" means. replace with "User session data (90 days)" or provide hover note. lina: accessibility note for hover: also provide an inline info button with aria-describedby pointing to the explanation so keyboard users can access it. joel: small CSS request: reduce .audit-row padding from 12px to 8px in compact. that'll keep single-line timestamps without reflow on most widths. sam: visual check — can we mock the row with KMS badge before/after? I'll upload an inline image in the next message. design-bot: mock uploaded: https://files.redwood/mockups/kms-compact-v2.png maya: thanks. last tiny copy thing: audit log export uses header "Key used" — legal wants "Encryption key (KMS)" for clarity. ok to update? anya: fine from infra side. will need migration for CSV headers only. lina: ensure header change is localized for i18n. joel: i'll send a PR with the compact CSS + badge reorder and a11y tooltip by EOD. sam: I'll update the copy strings: compact label, retention wording, export header. can we also add a short note in Console release notes about the KMS visibility change? maya: yes, add one-line release note: "Audit log: improved KMS badge placement and compact row behavior; better keyboard/tooltip support; copy clarifications for retention and export headers." anya: raising a quick follow-up: when we hide long key ids rely on permission checks in the API. flagging for security review. maya: good call — send the security review ticket once the PR is ready. :thumbsup:
